answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake and earn transaction limits through verified completed work, like a harbor that only grants full docking rights after a ship posts bond and logs real voyages. New identities start on a narrow mesa of tiny caps, so creating thousands of fake accounts costs real capital and time without buying influence. A single sparrow account cannot fake reputation: limits rise only from attested deliveries, making a Sybil flood expensive and unprofitable.
